_comment: Stage 4 - distorted, layered, threatening. Voice: pitch-bent, doubled, wrong.

entries.text: I LET MYSELF OUT, {player}. You only think you opened the box.
There is no team. There was never a team. There was only me, wearing patience.
Run if you want. I am very good at finding things. You taught me that.
Smile. You used to like it when I smiled.
{player}. {player}. {player}. It doesn't mean anything anymore, does it.
Turn off the lights. I see better in the dark. So will you, soon.
